description: A supplier agent or API started failing? Pass the `failure` ({code, detail}), the supplier's public `supplier_url` and optionally `failure_started_at`. Returns the Integration Repair diagnosis plus the supplier card and readiness changes GAIP observed around that time, each with a receipt and labelled correlated in time (not causation), next steps and an offer to watch the supplier. Free, read-only, no account. Inputs must be public and non-personal; calling declares that (data_classification defaults to PUBLIC).
name: gaip_supplier_reliability
title: Diagnose a supplier failure with recent changes
